items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, many times I worked with Johnny Lindsey. It's high, never was a member of the band.

ctx.x: Ask me if you work with Johnny Lindsey.

You ever work with Johnny Lindsey? Johnny Lindsey? Yeah, many times I worked with Johnny Lindsey. It's high, never was a member of the band. Is he living there? No. No, I tried he was there. He played drums. No, no, no, no. Bass and trombone.
Let me see, Johnny Lindsey? He's thinking of Joe Lindsey, you see.
